title: YouTube Guitar Tab Parser
claim: Show HN: YouTube Guitar Tab Parser
why_good: Extracts guitar tabs from YouTube videos — a specific, delightful pain-solver for a large hobbyist audience (guitarists).
value: Freemium for musicians: paid accurate transcription, library, export; Ultimate Guitar shows people pay for tabs.
risk: Copyright/licensing around music content is thorny, and accuracy of auto-tabbing is hard; niche willingness to pay.

zh.claim: Show HN: YouTube 吉他谱解析器。
zh.why_good: 从 YouTube 视频里提取吉他谱——给庞大的爱好者群体(吉他手)解决一个具体、讨喜的痛点。
zh.value: 给音乐人做免费增值:付费的精准转谱、曲库、导出;Ultimate Guitar 证明有人为谱付费。
zh.risk: 音乐内容的版权/授权很棘手,自动扒谱的准确度也难;付费意愿偏细分。
